title: Sparkline
summary: A sparkline: one series as a word-sized line, area or bars without axes, for a table cell, a line of text or a metric tile, named by its label and a sentence of what the data does.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

label.description: What the sparkline shows, in a few words: the start of its accessible name, before the sentence of what the data does. Without it the sparkline is named «Мини-график».

x.description: For records: the field of the order (time, a number or categories); the first field when unset. A list of numbers is in its own order.

y.description: For records: the field of the values; the first numeric field but x when unset.

shape.description: line: one line; area: the line with the ground under it filled lightly; bar: one thin bar per value, from zero.

curve.description: linear joins the points straight; step holds a value until the next; smooth is a curve that never goes past its points.

mark.description: A dot on the last value (last), on the highest and the lowest (extremes), or none. For bar the marked bars are drawn in full tone.

color.description: The colour of the line, the area and the bars: a Framework role (primary, secondary, tertiary, neutral, success, warning, error, info), which follows the theme, or any CSS colour or variable. It wins over --sf-chart-sparkline-color; a value that is not a colour is dropped with a console report, as is one under 3:1 against the background (drawn all the same).

y-zero.description: The value axis takes zero in. bar always does.

y-format.description: How the values are said in the accessible sentence: number, integer, decimal-<n>, percent (a share 0..1), compact or currency-<CODE>, in the page's language.

size.description: The rung of the size ladder: the height. 1/2 sits in a line of small text or a dense table, 1 in a table row, 2 in a metric tile.

summary.description: auto: the accessible name says what the data does after the label (the first and the last value, the highest and the lowest); none: the label alone, when the text around already says it.

data-state.description: auto: ready with data, empty without. loading holds the box with a quiet skeleton; empty draws a dotted baseline and says «нет данных».

items.description: The data: a list of numbers ([3, 5, 4]), a list of records ([{day, visits}, …]) or an object of columns. A missing value (null, '', a word) is a gap, never a zero.

accessibility.focus: None: not a Tab stop. The accessible name is the label and the sentence of what the data does.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-chart-sparkline for the shape of one series beside a number: in a table row, a sentence or the chart slot of sf-chart-metric.
do_not: Do not use it where a person must read the values; that is sf-chart-line with its axes and table
Do not replace missing values with zero
Do not draw it without a label
